shortDescription: Manages VLAN IP ranges on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account who owns the VLAN. Mutually exclusive with I(project).

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: cidr_ipv6
options.description: The CIDR of IPv6 network, must be at least /64.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain of the account owning the VLAN.

options.name: end_ip
options.description: The ending IPv4 address in the VLAN IP range. If not specified, value of I(start_ip) is used. Only considered on create.

options.name: end_ipv6
options.description: The ending IPv6 address in the IPv6 network range. If not specified, value of I(start_ipv6) is used. Only considered on create.

options.name: for_system_vms
options.description: C(true) if IP range is set to system vms, C(false) if not

options.name: for_virtual_network
options.description: C(true) if VLAN is of Virtual type, C(false) if Direct. If set to C(true) but neither I(physical_network) or I(network) is set CloudStack will try to add the VLAN range to the Physical Network with a Public traffic type.

options.name: gateway
options.description: The gateway of the VLAN IP range. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: gateway_ipv6
options.description: The gateway of the IPv6 network. Only considered on create.

options.name: netmask
options.description: The netmask of the VLAN IP range. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: network
options.description: The network name or id. Required if I(for_virtual_network) and I(physical_network) are not set.

options.name: physical_network
options.description: The physical network name or id.

options.name: pod
options.description: Name of the pod.

options.name: project
options.description: Project who owns the VLAN. Mutually exclusive with I(account).

options.name: start_ip
options.description: The beginning IPv4 address in the VLAN IP range. Only considered on create.

options.name: start_ipv6
options.description: The beginning IPv6 address in the IPv6 network range. Only considered on create.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the network ip range.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vlan
options.description: The ID or VID of the network. If not specified, will be defaulted to the vlan of the network.

options.name: zone
options.description: The Zone ID of the VLAN IP range.
